name: airplay-cpp
description: AirPlay 1 (RAOP) audio receiver in C++17 for ESP32 (ESP-IDF, Arduino), Zephyr and POSIX. ALAC and PCM, encrypted streams, playback synchronized to the sender's clock, volume, track details and remote control. No exceptions, no RTTI, no heap after setup.
keywords: airplay, raop, airtunes, audio, receiver, speaker, alac, streaming, esp32, zephyr, arduino
